title: Turns and headings
summary: Level turns onto new headings at 6,000 ft, by hand or with the heading mode, without losing the altitude.
briefing: Six thousand feet over Pennsylvania, two hundred and fifty knots, and she's all yours: the autopilot is off.
To turn, roll into about twenty-five degrees of bank, and as the heading comes up, roll out a little before it. Keep the altitude with a touch of back pressure in the turn.

tasks.goal: Turn right to heading 180 and hold it.
tasks.say: Turn right, heading one eight zero. Hold it there for ten seconds.

cues.say: That's steep: twenty-five degrees is plenty.

tasks.goal: Turn right to heading 300 and hold it.
tasks.say: Now keep going round to the right: heading three zero zero. If you'd like the autopilot's help, set the heading window and press HDG, then the autopilot, Q.

cues.say: We're off our altitude: six thousand.

tasks.goal: Turn right to heading 090 and hold it.
tasks.say: And back to where we started: heading zero niner zero, right turn.
tasks.done: Zero niner zero. A full circle, nearly.

debrief.three: Three turns and the altitude never strayed. Smooth flying.
debrief.two: Good turns. Hold the altitude a little tighter: a touch of back pressure as you roll in.
debrief.one: The headings are right; the altitude wandered. Watch the altimeter in the turn.
debrief.failed: That didn't go to plan. Gentle bank, and watch the altitude. Shall we go again?
